as_told.title: Eric Davis tells Congress the NHI are controlling disclosure

plain: At a closed-door hearing in Congress in 2025, a physicist named Eric Davis is said to have stated that "the NHI are controlling disclosure," meaning that non-human intelligence itself decides how and when the public learns about it. Michels tells this twice, once placing Davis at the closed session alongside Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small UFO study office, and the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb, and once calling it his favourite line from Davis while noting that he disagrees with Davis about the work of an inventor named Townsend Brown. If true, it would mean the timing of any revelation is not in human hands at all.
